text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Trainer-dono! I found it! I am certain this is the lady's bag!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I ended up helping search for a lost item while out,
and we finally managed to find it, but...

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, young lady.
It looks rather banged up here and there, but...
I'm just so glad to have it back.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
...My late husband gave this to me.
It's a precious memento...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: —I will!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I'll... put everything back the way it was!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh.
I knew this would happen, but... what a pain..."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, I think repairs will be difficult.
This manufacturer has already gone out of business.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: "It's a vintage piece that has deteriorated over time, and this latest damage only made things worse. Even for a master craftsman, restoring it perfectly would be—"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Even so!... I want to fix her precious memory for her.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
So please. Teach me how.
I don't want it to end with a sad smile like that!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I owe you from before anyway,
so I'll provide you with my technical expertise.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
However, we will need materials for that.
I will look into my connections, but I'll have to go around asking everywhere—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Even if not summoned, I arrive in a flash!
I'll go grab it at top speed!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: L-Light O-san!?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: So this is what you were fretting over last night. Consult me before agonizing over it. You're too slow to act.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I've arranged for hardware that matches
the original pieces as closely as possible.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
After school, Light O-san will dash over
to a nearby shop to pick it up for us.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Understood. So as for me—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono, I apologize.
For bringing in something like a sewing machine.
choice_data_list: Don't worry about it, feel free to use it however you like.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Resewing the inner lining, leather tabs, and fraying.
You will learn how to use a sewing machine specifically for leather.
First, sew in a straight line on practice material—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: ! Straight stitching is the one thing I'm famous for!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
It's meaningless unless I do it myself this time.
I appreciate the thought, but please just bear with it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And as several days passed by—

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
My... it looks so beautiful...!
It's just like back when my husband first gave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... Truly, thank you, young lady.
No. I should call you by name, Durandal, my savior.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"...I have a friend who taught me how to fix it.
I have a friend who ran around helping me gather the materials."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
If it were just me alone... I certainly couldn't have fixed it.
Therefore, please direct those kind words to my friends.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, you have such wonderful friends.
Oh, I know. In that case, why don't you share this with them—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
You two really saved the day this time.
...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
These sweets are good.
...Can I have another one?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Durandal-san was the one who actually fixed it.
I didn't really do anything special."
choice_data_list: They helped you because of who you are.
They helped you because of who you are.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I tell them that it must have been their earnest desire to help others and protect their smiles that spurred them into action.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Trainer-dono...!
choice_data_list: As your Trainer, I'm proud too
Maybe I should get you to help me next time
Maybe I'll ask for your help next time, too.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Trainer-dono...!
choice_data_list: As your Trainer, I'm proud too
Maybe I should get you to help me next time
Maybe I'll ask for your help next time, too.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Such kind words are more than I deserve...
I shall engrave them deeply upon my heart.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "I want to remain an upstanding person who can always reach out and lend a hand to others!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hm, true enough.
Durandal's got a loose smile on her face. Snapshot taken.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
L-Light O-san!?
Don't take weird photos!
choice_data_list: Haha, friends are a treasure for life, so cherish them.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Don't just wrap it up nicely like that,
someone stop Right O from taking photos!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Trainer-dono is in trouble?! Is that true?!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
There is no time like the present!
Let us begin at once, Trainer-dono!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Whether it's organizing paperwork or cleaning up, leave it all to Durandal!
